scope.goal: remove secret-ephemeral-dependent control and address variation from the first localized full-Sign remediation boundary
not_claimed: long-term signing-key leakage from the localized host branches
legacy byte identity for the protected Sign transcript
constant-time ideal construction after generator sampling

required_markers:
int
ibz_rand_interval(ibz_t *rand, const ibz_t *a, const ibz_t *b)

localized_paths.norm_mod_division: ibz_divrem_unsigned_wide -> ibz_div -> ibz_div_floor -> ibz_mod -> quat_alg_norm_mod -> random-ideal sampler

protected_coordinate_sampler.method: draw one fixed 769-bit integer and reduce it modulo N with the fixed-width dynamic-modulus reducer
schedule: read exactly 97 random bytes for every coordinate
mask the public seven excess high bits without a data-dependent branch
run the same fixed-width reduction schedule for every coordinate
publish only the reduced 513-bit coordinate after the complete schedule
protected_coordinate_sampler.distribution: not exact uniformity; the complete 394-coordinate product distribution is within 2^-248.37 total variation of uniform
protected_coordinate_sampler.rng_compatibility: fixed consumption intentionally differs from the legacy rejection sampler; freeze a separate protected transcript rather than claiming byte-identical legacy KAT output
protected_coordinate_sampler.rejected_shortcut: making ibz_cmp branchless while retaining early return, variable byte count or variable attempt count

rejected_inner_rejection_baseline.method: 128 fixed rejection attempts per coordinate followed by first-success selection
rejected_inner_rejection_baseline.reason: exact uniformity is available but would require 50432 candidate draws for one prime ideal under the 130/1 outer budget, making it an unsuitable first implementation Pareto point

gamma_candidate_work: sample all three non-scalar coordinates with the fixed wide-reduction sampler
compute quat_alg_norm_mod with fixed-width dynamic-modulus reduction
compute modular square root on the protected fixed-round route
evaluate nonzero and N^2-divisibility predicates without early exit and apply the primitive-lift correction
select the first valid gamma without early publication
beta_candidate_work: sample all four coordinates with the fixed wide-reduction sampler
select the first nonzero-norm beta without early publication

derivation.primitive_lift: if N^2 divides Q(x), replace the first nonzero canonical xi by xi-N; the residue class modulo N is unchanged and Q/N changes by -2*ai*xi mod N and becomes nonzero

outer_gamma_and_beta_schedule.failure_semantics: execute every scheduled candidate, clear the complete workspace, publish no partial ideal, and return a distinct fatal/exhausted status only after the fixed schedule
